references.text: God values human life highly, far above birds, which reminds us of our worth to Him.
The value of humans compared to animals is again emphasized, showing God's care for us.
This shows God's intimate knowledge and care for us, underscoring our worth to Him.
Even if a mother can forget her child, God will not forget us, which demonstrates our great worth to Him.
Jesus reminds us that we are more valuable than many sparrows, echoing the message in Matthew 10:31.
God's care for even the smallest details of our lives, including the hairs on our head, shows our worth to Him.
